source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001],

I appreciate [FREELANCER_NAME_002] thorough introduction — [FREELANCER_NAME_005] profile matches exactly what we need. You meet all our criteria: manual editing, [FREELANCER_NAME_002] proper tools, strong capacity for volume, and a long term outlook.

These are [FREELANCER_NAME_002] next steps:

Every clipper begins with an initial paid milestone consisting of 3 clips. This is [FREELANCER_NAME_002] standard onboarding procedure for all team members, no matter their experience level. It allows us to confirm that we are aligned on style and brand standard before proceeding to [FREELANCER_NAME_002] full contract.

[FREELANCER_NAME_005] instructions:
1. Review [FREELANCER_NAME_002] YouTube channel and Instagram that I will provide
2. Produce 3 clips using that content
3. Send them in by Sunday

Once we approve [FREELANCER_NAME_005] clips, we will arrange a video call so I can guide you through [FREELANCER_NAME_002] complete system — including [FREELANCER_NAME_005] daily task board, [FREELANCER_NAME_002] payment dashboard for tracking [FREELANCER_NAME_005] earnings each day, [FREELANCER_NAME_005] assigned Instagram account, and everything required for you to get started effectively.

Compensation structure:
— $2.00 CPM for each 1,000 views
— Payout capped at $600 per clip
— Performance bonuses offered weekly and monthly

To be straightforward — considering [FREELANCER_NAME_005] volume capacity and [FREELANCER_NAME_002] leadership mindset you already demonstrated in [FREELANCER_NAME_005] message, [FREELANCER_NAME_002] Lead Clipper path is absolutely available to you as you develop with us.

Confirm that you are ready, and I will send [FREELANCER_NAME_002] links now.
